content: {"like":["Values clear, satisfying conclusions and well‑articulated evolution of creatures; appreciates thoughtful, well‑paced storytelling and insightful character interviews; enjoys high‑quality releases with expanded extras and nods to classic influences; favors films that blend humor with purpose and maintain a respectful tone; appreciates films that explore loneliness and silence in a beautiful, contemplative way."],"dislike":["Dislikes predictable, clichéd plot developments and repetitive endings; finds gratuitous cursing and over‑the‑top language off‑putting; criticizes shallow or ill‑developed characters, especially those who lack common sense or depth; rejects films that feel derivative or heavily borrow from other works without originality; is turned off by excessive contrast or technical flaws that break immersion."]}
